errors.text: The proposed intervention is Cr addition plus unspecified process optimization, rather than the target high-energy ball milling followed by spark plasma sintering.
It does not define a specific alloy composition, Cr concentration, or processing window, so the intervention is not reproducible or genuinely single.
The predicted outcome contains no quantitative hardness, strength, or allowable ductility-loss criterion.
The stated boundary concerns evidence transferability rather than physical limits such as milling duration, sintering temperature, grain coarsening, or phase decomposition.
